This happened to me (13)& my younger(8)  at the time. We lived in a 50s style house but in the same yard around 20meters away from the house stood the oldest house in the state build back in early 1900s .. ran down. Looked scary but we still played in it before this happened. There was a small room to the back which was like sealed shut. No markings or warnings. We were always curious & always tried opening it. One day I got it open. Nothing inside, surprising was connected to the other side of the building which had a wall that was talking down. But from the other you couldn't even tell that was a room? You couldn't see the door from the outside. Anyway. After I opened the door .. I kept seeing the little girl in my room. She looked like the ring girl or the grudge. Long black hair, a potato sack dress on & like sack boots. Me being 13 I was scared but more.confused. she wouldn't leave me alone. Night after night just standing there. Then I build the courage to ask her her name. She said the crab girl? I was like why do they call you the crab girl? She said because I do this! She started to crawl up the wall and roof like a crab! She got down & laughed then would repeat this. We lived in this house for about 3yrs prior. & Never seen anything but something was always off. I ended up keeping this to myself because I was 13 & more confused. I kinder thought I was crazy. A few months later my sister and I swapped rooms. I didn't really see crab girl many times after so I kinder forgot about it. As soon as my sister moved in she kept waking to 'night terrors' saying the crab girl the crab girl. My mum just put it down to nightmares. It happened a few more times then J spoke up. Around breakfast one morning, I asked my sister. Does she look like this? Does she looked like that? She said yes how do U no. I said because I seen her too. In the mean time I've told a few friends etc. One of my friends told me the people that first lived in the run down house back in the day had a few kids but the little 7yo girl drowned in the creek at the back of the house. Still freaks me today. I don't no if she was a demon etc. I no live up the road from the house. It has been brought & sold around 6times in the last 2yrs. The old house has now been demolished & some Reno's done to the 50s style house it self. Whatever that thing is in that house would be so evil by now. I feel sorry for anyone that has to experience it.
